invariants.rationale: records.collectAsList() should not return null; an empty list is returned if there are no records.
If there are elements in records, the result will not be empty, and vice versa.
The size of the resulting list should equal the number of records in the input HoodieData.
All elements in the resulting list should be instances of HoodieRecord.
records must not be null to safely call records.collectAsList().
